title: Hardware-Efficient Quantum Optimization for Transportation Networks via Compressed Adiabatic Evolution
summary: Transportation systems such as urban logistics, vehicle routing, and infrastructure planning require solving large-scale combinatorial optimization problems under complex constraints. Problems such as the vehicle routing problem (VRP), traveling salesman problem (TSP), and facility location problem (FLP) involve large discrete search spaces and the need to generate multiple feasible solutions in real time.
